description: Mexican port cargo and vessel arrival statistics provides monthly port cargo and vessel-arrival statistics with port, month, cargo type, traffic, entry and exit fields. The provider is Secretaría de Marina (SEMAR). Geographical and temporal coverage: The Mexican maritime authority's page lists CSV data for December 2025 to January 2026 and warns of retroactive revisions. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
